exploit_name: Missing authorization check allows unauthorized fund withdrawal from any account
description: The withdraw() and redeem() functions lack verification that msg.sender is authorized to act on behalf of the owner. While the Vault checks allowance with the share token, it never validates the relationship between caller and owner.
root_cause: The withdraw() and redeem() functions lack verification that msg.sender is authorized to act on behalf of the owner. While the Vault checks allowance with the share token, it never validates the relationship between caller and owner.
fix_description: Add authorization check verifying msg.sender is the owner or has sufficient allowance.
notes: Anyone can drain funds from approved accounts. Direct theft of user assets.
